page_notes_zh.1: UG/Graduate；影像語言：UG不收officialcert但英/西足夠聽課考試，general最低B1強烈建議B2、工程B2硬性、部分現代語課B2/C1硬性。零西語強烈建議學前密集西語，常規零初學課不保證；密集及常規語言課免學費但教材例外，選英語者來前核足夠英課。MA/PhD常需授課語C1各課程不同，須programme主任批准可再要ToR，不能B1套全部或當全體初申要ToR。原生沒有整段語言表，另存人工影像選定摘錄。
page_notes_zh.2: 秋Sep–Jan春Feb–June未年。學術offer及住宿/visa舊shortlinks只是入口，未讀不能當已核房價/法律；完整初申截止／預算未列。

page_transcriptions.text:
UNDERGRADUATE STUDENTS
No official certificate is required. Students should have enough knowledge of either Spanish or English to follow lessons and sit exams.
In general, minimum B1, although a B2 is strongly recommended.
A B2 in either language is compulsory for Engineering degrees.
A B2 or C1 is compulsory for some courses from the Modern Language degree.
Both courses are free of charge (except learning materials).
MASTER & PhD STUDENTS
Each master or PhD programme might have a different language requirement, but a C1 in the language of tuition is usually required.
Permission for acceptance must be forwarded to the director of the programme who might also require further documents such as the Transcript of Records to decide on the acceptance of the exchange student.
